description: GitHub Actions CICD for npm release and staging package preparation

finalSuccessCriteria.description: The CLI package can be validated, built, packaged, and published from versioned release branches, while staging branches produce a package state that can be installed directly from the GitHub repository link without publishing to npm.
acceptanceCriteria: A GitHub Actions workflow handles the CLI npm package from the existing cli workspace without disrupting the current CI and GitHub Pages workflows

Pushes to release branches matching release/vX.Y.Z validate the package, verify the branch version matches cli/package.json, build the CLI, run package preview checks, and publish @samuelchung/ralph-cli to npm using the NPM_TOKEN secret
Release publishing uses npm public package settings and avoids committing or printing npm credentials
Pushes to staging branches matching staging/vX.Y.Z-* validate and build the CLI package without publishing to npm

Staging branches leave the package installable from the GitHub repository ref, for example npm install github:samchung95/ralph-cli#staging/vX.Y.Z-rc.1, by ensuring the package can prepare its dist output during git-based npm install
The workflow uses lockfile-based installs, Node.js 20, and the strongest available package checks: typecheck, build, init test, and npm pack dry run
README or CLI package documentation describes the release branch convention, staging branch convention, required NPM_TOKEN secret, and how to install a staging ref from GitHub
Relevant verification commands pass locally where possible

planning.currentObjective: Document the npm release/staging workflow and staging GitHub install path

promptExpansion.intent: Add a reliable GitHub Actions release path for the npm CLI package and a staging path that supports testing branch builds through npm's GitHub dependency install flow.
inScope: GitHub Actions workflow for cli package release and staging branches
Release branch pattern and version validation
Staging branch package preparation for git-based npm install
CLI package scripts needed to support GitHub repo installs
outOfScope: Changing the GitHub Pages flowchart deploy workflow except to avoid conflicts
Changing the package name or repository ownership
Adding unrelated release automation such as changelog generation unless required for the publish workflow
assumptions: The production release branch convention should be release/vX.Y.Z, where X.Y.Z must match cli/package.json version
The staging branch convention should be staging/vX.Y.Z-* for release candidates or pre-release testing
Upload means publishing the npm package to the public npm registry rather than GitHub Packages
The npm automation token will be provided as the GitHub Actions secret NPM_TOKEN
The package should continue to be built from the cli directory in this monorepo-style repository

included: security check for npm credentials and workflow permissions
test hardening limited to available package verification commands
successCriteriaResearch: Reviewed cli/package.json and found scripts for typecheck, build, test:init, pack:dry-run, prepack, and prepublishOnly
Reviewed existing .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/deploy.yml to avoid disrupting current CI and Pages deployment
Reviewed README.md and cli/README.md release/package sections for places to document branch conventions and staging installs
